items.title: WIP: feat: add gt skill to install agent skills from repositories
items.body:
`gt` had no way to hand its agent skill (`skills/gt`) or any other skill to a coding agent. `gt skill` follows `gh skill`:

- `install <repository> [<skill>]` copies skills, or all with `--all`, to the skills directory of `--agent` (default `universal`, i.e. `.agents/skills`) at `--scope project|user`, or to `--dir`. `--from-local` reads a local directory, `--pin REF` installs a tag or commit that `update` leaves alone.
- `list`, `preview` and `update [--dry-run|--force|--unpin]` show what is installed, print a skill before installing it, and replace skills whose tree changed.
- The repository is on any Gitea instance gt has an account for (`HOST/OWNER/NAME` or a URL), or a public `https://github.com/OWNER/NAME`, read anonymously with no credentials sent. The source and tree SHA go into the `metadata` of the installed `SKILL.md`, which `update` compares.

Skills are read at one commit, limited in size and file count, and a name that is not a plain skill name is refused so nothing is written outside the skills directory.

Agent directories were checked against what `gh skill install` writes; other directories work with `--dir`. `search` and `publish` are not included.
